Developing an enterprise recruitment and manpower management application for Bosch to streamline hiring requests, resource planning, and workforce tracking.

Description: Developed an internal enterprise productivity monitoring application for Bausch + Lomb focused on collecting and analyzing real-time machine data. The application enables administrators to monitor machine performance, production metrics, and operational insights through interactive dashboards and reports. Operators can log breaks, report issues, and update machine statuses, ensuring accurate shop-floor visibility. Implemented secure role-based access to differentiate admin and operator functionalities, improving operational efficiency and workforce productivity. The system supports robust data workflows, advanced tabular analysis, and visual reporting to help management make data-driven decisions.

Responsibilities:

 Developed modular React + Next.js components with Tailwind CSS and Daisy UI for clean UI, responsive

layouts, and reusable design patterns. Utilized Pre-React Signals to build highly reactive forms and state-driven UIs without relying on third-party state management libraries.

 Implemented WebSockets to stream real-time machine status updates, operator actions, and dashboard

refreshes without page reloads.

 role-based access control (RBAC) to secure routes, APIs, and user permissions.  Developed and consumed RESTful APIs using FAST API with Python for machine data ingestion, operator

actions, audit logs, and permission configurations.

Description: Developed an internal enterprise application for vehicle audit and validation at Renault. The project focused on robust data workflows, real-time reporting, and secure role-based access. Leveraged Angular 18 standalone components with Signals for reactive state management, integrated AG Grid for advanced tabular data operations, and used AG Charts for visual dashboards. Backend was built using Node with Nest js and integrated with secure Keycloak SSO. Responsibilities:
❖ Developed modular Angular standalone components with Tailwind CSS for clean UI and responsive layouts. ❖ Utilized Angular Signals to build highly reactive forms and state-driven UIs without third- party state management libraries. ❖ Implemented AG Grid for handling large-scale datasets with pagination, sorting, filtering, row selection, and cell editing. ❖ Integrated AG Charts to deliver real-time insights and interactive dashboards for audit analytics. ❖ Used Keycloak for SSO, OAuth2, and role-based access control (RBAC) to secure route and API access. ❖ Developed and consumed RESTful APIs using Node with Nest js for inspection workflows, audit logs, and permission configurations. ❖ Containerized backend services using Docker and deployed through CI/CD pipelines in Jenkins. ❖ Used PostgreSQL with Spring Data JPA to manage relational audit records with validations and optimized queries.
